title: Every wedding has its characters
request: ONE 25-second vertical Envitefy.com wedding mockumentary: The Planner opens invitation, RSVPs, adds to calendar, reveals garment bag and says Been ready since February. The Dancer reads details, RSVPs and rehearses ambitious dancing alone. The Crier tears up, partner silently slides tissues while they RSVP. Quick cuts of all three at the wedding. End: Every wedding has its characters. Bring yours together. Envitefy.com. Natural performances, documentary zooms, elegant wedding visuals, actual branding, clear RSVP and Add to Calendar close-ups.
audience: Engaged couples planning a wedding and their delightfully individual guests
concept: Three fictional guests, three tiny documentary portraits, one beautiful garden wedding. Restrained character labels and editorial wedding typography; observed comedy, natural reactions and quick optical zooms.
audio: One naturally lip-synced Planner line. Original light pizzicato and brushed-drum comedy groove, tasteful transition into wedding celebration, footsteps and tissue rustle. No narrator.
